niche_preference_profile: This user consistently prefers interfaces that make core content easy to scan and act on: clear hierarchy, visible metadata, prominent actionable controls, and layouts that prioritize the main task over decorative or competing modules. They often like polished, premium styling with refined spacing, consistent cards, rounded components, and restrained accent use. They also repeatedly favor denser but well-structured information presentation, where more useful items are visible at once without feeling messy. In several cases they prefer lighter, airier, more approachable screens with high readability, but their theme preference is not fully stable across contexts.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers strong, structured hierarchy with clearly separated sections, obvious progression, and emphasis on the most important content first.
Prefers primary actions that are obvious, enabled-looking, well-labeled, and visually distinct from secondary controls.
Prefers layouts that support quick scanning through structured rows/cards, visible comparable details, aligned metadata, and concise labels.
Prefers screens that prioritize the main workflow and core content over decorative imagery, secondary modules, or competing utilities.
Prefers refined, cohesive visual execution with consistent cards, spacing, dividers, rounded elements, and generally more premium-looking component treatment.
Prefers fewer distracting interface elements around the main task, with cleaner compositions and reduced competition from extra controls or modules.
Prefers controls, tabs, chips, and filters that are clearly grouped, easy to parse, and provide useful granularity for decision-making or browsing.
